_comment: Six documents, in creation order. Each row demonstrates exactly one rule; see README.md. Ids are assigned by the board in this order, so LP-1..LP-6 are stable.

issues.title: Payments
issues.body: The scope root. Everything below it is mirrored; nothing above it is.

issues.title: Card payments

issues.title: Refund a captured charge

issues.title: Refund a voided charge
issues.body: A finished story: its status is the terminal one.
